predict.question: Each decision needs Prepare, Approve and Act. B handles 6, 8 and 6 decisions/hour at those steps. How many completed decisions per hour can B sustain?

exploreHint: Run both cases; compare the changed input.
bookIdea: Turn the Ship Around! describes moving authority toward people able to act on local knowledge.
modelBoundary: Every decision needs all three steps. A completes {A} decisions/hour; B completes {B}. B’s approval handles eight, but preparation and action each cap completions at six. Knowledge quality, military operations and leadership outcomes are not modeled.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? The arithmetic follows our assumptions; real-world applicability and book attribution remain unverified.
